audit_reference: 10.6 Five-Country Canonical Coverage Audit & Expansion Plan v1
verdict: Automation CAN start now for AU/GB/CA/IE institution+course and AU occupation workloads; US and IE occupations require additional data source work first (GAP-005, GAP-006).

AU: CRICOS snapshot -> canonical (currently ad-hoc python into public)
US: College Scorecard API -> institutions/programmes (key present in .env.local)

gitignore_related.note: cricos_* (AU), hea_* (GB), qualifax_* (IE) repo-root files are gitignored, so raw snapshots are not versioned. data/raw has no AU/GB/US/CA/IE folders.
gitignore_related.risk: source lineage cannot be reproduced from repo alone

runtime_dependencies.origin_comparison_tables: concept_career_mappings, career_compensation_observations, housing_cost_observations, country_comparison_coverage return 404 via REST (migration-only). Automation must not assume these are observable.
runtime_dependencies.api_private: server-only read model; automation for non-AU read models is out of scope until v1.1

prerequisites_before_automation: Decide where raw snapshots live (data/raw/{au,gb,us,ca,ie} tracking policy)
Establish canonical GB naming (uk-* fixtures vs gb-*)
Confirm origin-comparison tables exist in production DB (may be migration-not-applied)

recommended_first_automation.priority_1: AU CRICOS snapshot ingestion into catalog via canonical pipeline (replaces ad-hoc public writes)
